messages:
sara: Quick heads-up — planning a cross-repo merge window tomorrow 10:00 PT. PRs to land together: sdk#412 (auth header rename), api#988 (client compatibility shim), console#123 (menu id rename), helm#56 (values restructure). Runtime needs the new helm image tag to pick up KV cache change. Any blockers?

ben: I still need one more approval on sdk#412, pinged @kevin for a security review. otherwise LGTM from my side.

maria: api#988 has integration tests failing in CI (timeout on request batching). I reproduced locally, looks like a shim race. Will push a fix by EOD.

kevin: Reviewing sdk#412 now. If security asks for small tweaks I can fast-track. Concern: the header rename might break older clients; we need a compatibility flag in api.

jon: console#123 is purely a rename + spec update, no runtime changes. I added a migration note in the PR description.

ben: helm#56 needs to bump the image tag. Current chart values snippet i added to the PR:
```yaml
image:
  repository: redwood/runtime
  tag: v2.3.0-rc
  pullPolicy: IfNotPresent
```
Will update to v2.3.0 once runtime build finishes.

ci-bot: build/runtime:v2.3.0-rc passed smoke tests on staging at 2025-11-08T18:10:02Z :white_check_mark:

maria: pushed a small fix to api#988, CI green now. @sara you can re-run presubmit when ready.

sara: thanks. Plan: aim to merge at 10:00 PT. Order: api -> sdk -> console -> helm (helm needs the final image tag). Can we do a canary deploy at 10:15 PT to staging, then full roll at 10:30 if GA metrics look good?

kevin: sounds good. I'll prioritize the final security review so sdk#412 can merge right after api.

ben: i'll coordinate the helm tag update right after runtime build finishes. if anyone needs me to hold a PR just react with :hand:.

jon: will be available for quick follow-ups during the window. If console needs a rollback, toggling feature flag `ui.menu_v2` is all we need.

maria: i'll monitor batching metrics and post a short perf snapshot to this thread at 10:20 PT.

sara: perfect — thanks all. tagging the runtime oncall for visibility: @kevin. I'll post a final go/no-go 09:50 PT. :thumbsup:
